gloom_horn.description: The Gloom Horn; `use` blows grey mist.

kite.description: A kite: held, it flies on its string.

apple.description: A red apple: hold and `eat`, or toss it.

cart.description: A hand cart of vegetables (set_object toX).

market_stall.description: A market stall with an awning and baskets.

basket.description: A lidded basket: carry it or break it.

bus.description: The friendly village bus: cream and teal with luggage on the roof (set_object toX or exit).

campfire.description: A small campfire: crossed logs, flickering flames, a ring of stones (state out: smoke).

giant_pot.description: A huge round cooking pot of bubbling curry over a fire, with rising steam.

ladle.description: A long wooden ladle, held like a staff (staff moves work); the Orange crystal can sit in its cup.

lever.description: A wall lever on a block: state up or down (it opens the trapdoor in a story).

trapdoor.description: A plank trapdoor in the floor: closed or open (someone on it drops out of the scene with jump_down).

rope_bridge.description: A wooden rope bridge across a gap; set_object state broken drops it in two hanging halves.

pirate_ship.description: Captain Kanta's small pirate ship on the water: round hull, portholes, a patched sail and a fish flag (set_object toX or exit).

rowboat.description: A small wooden rowboat with two oars, sitting in the water (ride it; set_object toX).

raft.description: A wobbly raft of tied logs on the water; set_object state broken: it comes apart and sinks.

fishing_net.description: A fishing net with floats: closed drops over someone (captured with wrap net), open lies in a heap.

treasure_chest.description: A wooden treasure chest with gold trim; open shows shiny coins.

lantern_string.description: A string of round paper lanterns in many colours between two poles, glowing softly.

ribbon.description: A pink ribbon bow lying on the ground (Doomi's trail).

dhol.description: A red and gold barrel drum (dhol) on a strap; `use` beats it.

windup_key.description: Iron Ghoom's big brass wind-up key, pulled off his back.

pot_and_pan.description: A frying pan, held like a bat: the village's funny shield (bat moves work).

mirror.description: A tall standing mirror in a curly purple frame; set_object state broken cracks it (no sharp shards).

snowball.description: A big rolling snowball (an avalanche throws them).

rock_round.description: A round grey rock that rolls.

hanging_cage.description: A round bird-cage cage hanging from a chain, big enough for a person; closed or open.

rainbow_bridge.description: A shimmering rainbow arc rising from the ground up and out of the sky (the friends' glow).

rainbow_shield.description: A pulsing dome of rainbow light that protects whoever stands inside it.

neutral.description: Calm and blank: dot eyes, a straight mouth.

laugh.description: Eyes squeezed into arcs, a big grin.

cry.description: Eyes shut, a wobbly mouth and tears.

angry.description: Brows down and a frown; shows teeth when talking.

furious.description: Very angry: teeth bared and an anger vein.

scared.description: Wide eyes, raised brows, a wobbly mouth and sweat.

surprised.description: Wide eyes, brows up, an O mouth.

determined.description: Focused brows and a firm mouth.

love.description: Heart eyes, blush and floating hearts.

dizzy.description: Spiral eyes and a wobbly mouth.

hurt.description: Eyes squeezed shut, mouth open in pain.

asleep.description: Closed eyes and a little O mouth.

stickman.description: The classic stick figure (the v1 body); all-round.

buddy.description: A short, round, cute sidekick with a filled body and big eyes.

kid.description: A small child stick figure with big eyes.

bulky.description: A big, broad, strong figure with a filled chest and thick brows.

robot.description: A big iron robot: a rounded box body with rivets, a square head, bolts at the joints (Iron Ghoom).

slim.description: A tall, thin figure with oval eyes; sneaky or elegant.

elder.description: An older figure with a stoop, sleepy eyes and white hair.

dog_small.description: A small four-legged puppy (back at a stickman's knee) with floppy ears and a wagging tail; never fights.

blow_bubbles.description: One blows bubbles with a wand while friends poke and pop them; ends laughing.

tennis_rally.description: Two players hit a tennis ball over the net until one misses.

play_catch.description: Two friends toss and catch a ball; ends laughing.

kick_ball.description: Two friends kick a football back and forth.

eat_together.description: Friends sit (on a bench or chairs) and eat together.

selfie.description: One takes a selfie with the phone while the others cheer.

sleep.description: Characters lie down (on a bench if given) and sleep.

comfort.description: One comforts a crying friend, ending in a hug.

fetch.description: A friend throws a ball and a dog fetches it back in its mouth; ends laughing.

rivals: Not if I can help it!

happy.description: Bright and cheerful major-key tune; a sunny day.

playful.description: Bouncy toy-like tune for games and silly moments.

calm.description: Slow, dreamy flute and bells; quiet moments.

sad.description: Slow minor flute; loss and missing someone.

mysterious.description: Glassy, eerie and slow; caves, secrets, the unknown.

heroic.description: Brassy and brave; setting off on a quest.

boss.description: Fast, dark and heavy; the final fight against the villain.

triumphant.description: Big brassy victory; the happy ending.

lullaby.description: Slow music box; bedtime and sleep.

flat.description: No lighting: the plain v2 look with no shading, rim or cast shadows.

noon.description: Bright midday sun high on the right: soft two-tone shading, short shadows, a light blue haze far away.

dawn.description: Low pink morning light from the left: long soft shadows and a rosy haze.

golden.description: Golden hour from low on the right: warm lit sides, cool violet shadows, long shadows and a warm haze.

moonlit.description: Cool blue moonlight from high on the left: dark shadow sides, a pale rim and a deep blue haze.

indoor.description: A warm lamp overhead and slightly to the right: gentle shading, soft shadows on the floor and a flattened shadow on the wall behind.

stage.description: A hard spotlight from straight above: strong three-tone shading, a tight shadow at the feet and no haze.

gloom.description: Dim greenish light from the left for villain lairs: murky shading, heavy shadows and a thick dark haze.

push_in.description: A slow dolly toward the stage: near things grow faster than far ones, so the scene deepens.

pull_out.description: A dolly back from the stage that reveals more of the place around the characters.

slow_push.description: A gentle zoom in over a few seconds, for a quiet or emotional moment.

crane_up.description: The camera rises and tilts down a little, as if on a crane, for an opening or an ending.

crane_down.description: The camera comes down from high above to the characters' height.

orbit_sweep.description: A sideways glide with a small push in and out, so the layers slide past each other.

dutch_tilt.description: The frame leans a few degrees to one side for a funny or uneasy moment.

level.description: Back to a straight, still camera: no lean, crane, truck or dolly.

handheld.description: A light handheld sway that keeps going after the move, for lively or nervous scenes.

title.description: A big bouncy cartoon title: yellow letters with a thick dark outline and a drop shadow.

subtitle.description: A clean white line under a title, with a soft dark outline.

caption.description: Plain white words on a dark rounded box near the bottom of the frame.

lower_third.description: A name strip: white text on a coloured bar, for introducing a character.

comic.description: A comic sound word: red letters with a white outline, for a pop or a bonk.

label.description: Small dark letters for a sign or a label inside the picture.

presets.name: Becky
presets.description: A brave little cream puppy with a brown eye patch and a red collar; sniffs out trouble and barks first.

presets.name: Grandpa Bo
presets.description: A kind grandpa who runs the corner shop; a friendly face in town scenes.

presets.name: Brute
presets.description: A huge bruiser who works for the villain; big and strong (scale 1.3, 160 hp).

presets.name: Passer-by
presets.description: A background adult for streets and crowds (copy with new ids and colors).

presets.name: Kid
presets.description: A background kid for crowds, parks and cheering (copy with new ids and colors).

presets.name: Dony
presets.description: Doopi's loyal best friend in leaf green with a yellow cap and scarf; a worrier who always shares his food.

presets.name: Doomi
presets.description: Clever pink planner with a ponytail and a flower clip; kind to everyone, great at puzzles, ribbons and flips.

presets.name: Doopi
presets.description: The sky-blue hero of Tokyo: spiky hair, a red headband, big eyes; big-hearted, brave and very clumsy.

presets.name: Iron Ghoom
presets.description: A giant iron robot with a glowing visor and a brass wind-up key in his back; wound up by Peepa, gentle once he is free (Ghoomu).

presets.name: Grey Goon
presets.description: One of Peepa's grey helpers: a big, slow, silly guard in grey armour who is easy to trick.

presets.name: Guard
presets.description: A broad yellow guard who blocks the way; good in groups (guard1, guard2...).

presets.name: Kai
presets.description: A brave young fighter with a red headband; kind to friends, fearless in a fight.

presets.name: Captain Kanta
presets.description: A loud pirate captain in a navy coat, an eyepatch and a fish-badge tricorn; loves treasure and hates baths.

presets.name: Kony
presets.description: Tony's softer almost-twin in grey with a blue cap and glued-on stub horns; a bit kind, Mooka's secret friend.

presets.name: Mallu Uncle
presets.description: A cheerful old boatman with a round white beard and a white cap; he rows the friends across Lotus Lake.

presets.name: Madam Mirchi
presets.description: A spice sorceress in a red robe and a tall chilli hat; her chilli smoke makes everyone sneeze, but she can't stand sweets.

presets.name: Mooka
presets.description: A round mint-green jelly-bean buddy with a leaf sprout, a lavender belly and orange mittens; giggly and innocent.

presets.name: Motumal
presets.description: Tokyo's round, pompous mayor with a big moustache, a saffron turban and an orange coat; kind and scared of everything.

presets.name: Nani Nimbu
presets.description: A tiny stooped granny with a white bun, round glasses and a purple shawl; strict, funny, spins her cane like a staff.

presets.name: Peepa
presets.description: Tall dark-violet villain with curly golden ram horns, thick brows and a long dark cape; dramatic, vain and lonely.

presets.name: Pip
presets.description: Kai's small round buddy with an antenna and a squeaky voice; cheerful and a bit clumsy.

presets.name: Rook
presets.description: A proud rival fighter with a staff and a scarf; tough but fair.

presets.name: Sage
presets.description: An old master in a robe with a cane; calm, wise and full of advice.

presets.name: Sly
presets.description: A sneaky masked henchman who creeps and tiptoes; fast but not strong.

presets.name: Tam
presets.description: A playful kid with spiky hair who loves ball games.

presets.name: Tara Treetop
presets.description: A brave, bossy forest girl in orange with a ponytail and a green scarf; knows every path in the Whispering Forest.

presets.name: Thunda
presets.description: A huge brown-red wrestler-bandit with a big moustache and armor; very strong, very slow, gets dizzy when he spins.

presets.name: Tony
presets.description: Peepa's bossy mini boy in grey with a red cap and glued-on stub horns; boastful, cowardly, always messes up.

presets.name: Vex
presets.description: A tall, thin villain in a black cape with a deep voice; tougher than most (200 hp).

roles.name: hero
roles.description: The main character the story follows.

roles.name: sidekick
roles.description: The hero's loyal companion, often small and funny.

roles.name: friend
roles.description: A friend who plays, helps or needs help.

roles.name: mentor
roles.description: A wise teacher who guides the hero.

roles.name: villain
roles.description: The main troublemaker of the story.

roles.name: rival
roles.description: A competitor who challenges the hero, not always bad.

roles.name: guard
roles.description: Stands watch and blocks the way.

roles.name: crowd
roles.description: Extras in the background: passers-by, a cheering crowd.

roles.name: animal-like
roles.description: A creature-like character (big eyes, antenna, squeaky voice).

sfx.name: whoosh
sfx.description: A swish of fast motion (attacks, dashes).

sfx.name: block
sfx.description: A hit stopped by a block.

sfx.name: land_heavy
sfx.description: A heavy body hitting the floor.

sfx.name: bell
sfx.description: A boxing bell (round start or end).

sfx.name: bark
sfx.description: A dog's woof: a short falling bark.

sfx.name: card_whoosh
sfx.description: A whoosh for title and chapter cards.

sfx.name: gloom_horn
sfx.description: The Gloom Horn: a low wobbly horn blast that falls in a minor key, with a mist hiss.

sfx.name: sneeze
sfx.description: A comic sneeze: ah... ah... CHOO!

sfx.name: crystal_chime
sfx.description: A bright bell arpeggio for a glowing crystal.

sfx.name: pirate_horn
sfx.description: A bright two-note ship horn (pirates coming!).

sfx.name: splash
sfx.description: Something falls into the water: a thump and a spray.

sfx.name: robot_stomp
sfx.description: A giant robot's step: a deep thud with a metal ring.

sfx.name: robot_beep
sfx.description: A robot's two-tone beep, high then low.

sfx.name: windup_click
sfx.description: A wind-up key turning: a ratchet of quick clicks.

eyes.visor: A sci-fi visor across the eyes.

hair.bun: A round bun on top with a hairpin.

accessories.hat: A hat on top of the head.
accessories.hair_flower: A five-petal flower clip above the ear.
accessories.sprout: A two-leaf sprout on top of the head.
accessories.horns: Two curly ram horns curving back.
accessories.turban: A wrapped turban with a jewel (headwear; covers the hair).
accessories.stub_horns: Two tiny glued-on toy horns (remove for a gag).
accessories.bracelet: A left-wrist band with seven gems; `slots` 0-7 lights them in rainbow order.
accessories.chilli_hat: A tall curved red-chilli hat with a green cap (headwear; covers the hair).
accessories.pirate_hat: A pirate tricorn with a gold trim and a fish emblem (headwear; covers the hair).
accessories.windup_key: A big brass wind-up key in the back that turns slowly (Iron Ghoom).

voices.name: squeaky
voices.description: A high, squeaky voice: buddies, small or comic characters.

voices.name: bark
voices.description: A dog's voice: every syllable is a little woof.

voices.name: deep
voices.description: A low, deep voice: big characters, villains, elders.

ambience.name: city_traffic
ambience.description: A low traffic rumble with cars passing (streets).

ambience.name: park_birds
ambience.description: A soft breeze and birds chirping (parks).

ambience.name: cave_drip
ambience.description: A quiet room tone and echoing drips (caves, lairs).

shake.description: Shakes the camera: small, med or big.

slowmo.description: Slow motion for `duration` story seconds at `scale` speed; great on a big hit.

freeze.description: Freezes the action for a moment (hitstop) without stopping the video.

zoom_punch.description: A quick camera punch-in that springs back.

fade.description: Fades the picture out to black or white (or back in with dir in).

desaturate.description: Drains the color from the picture (sad or dramatic moments).

text_pop.description: A big comic word pops up on screen (16 characters at most).

caption.description: A line of caption text at the top, bottom or center.

explosion.description: An explosion at a stage position.

spawn_prop.description: Puts a prop on the floor for someone to pick up.

prop_break.description: Breaks the prop a character is holding.

set_theme.description: Switches the background theme (v1 clips; stories use scenes).

music_cue.description: Starts, stops or ducks the music.

cut.description: A hard cut in the camera (no params).

narrate.description: Narration text in a box at the top or bottom (stories).

params.text: One sunny morning, Kai met Pip in the park.

title_card.description: A full-screen title card with an optional subtitle.

set_time.description: Changes the time of day, fading over `dur` seconds.

set_weather.description: Changes the weather, fading over `dur` seconds.

spawn_object.description: Adds an object from the catalog to the scene.

remove_object.description: Removes the object named in the beat's `object` field.

set_object.description: Changes an object (named in `object`): a state, or sends a ball, floater or vehicle moving.

set_appearance.description: Changes how a character looks mid-story: add or remove an accessory, change hair, outfit or eyes.

sfx.description: Plays one sound effect on its own (an off-screen horn, thunder); x pans it.

set_glow.description: A lasting glow around a character: a color or "rainbow", level 0-1 (0: off), over dur; carries over scenes.

set_grade.description: Scene colour: saturation 1 full, 0 grey, over dur; keepCast keeps the cast in colour; from: a wave out from a character.

shot.description: A camera shot from a beat (wide, close_up, two_shot, ...); with dur the previous framing comes back.

set_music.description: Changes the music mood, intensity or volume inside a scene.

activity.description: Runs an activity directly (the runtime form of @activity; prefer the macro).

set_light.description: The light rig of a version 3 scene: a preset (noon, dawn, golden, moonlit, indoor, stage, gloom, flat) or overrides (angle, strength, fog), blended over dur.

set_camera.description: The lens of a version 3 scene: a named move (push_in, pull_out, crane_up, orbit_sweep, dutch_tilt, level, handheld ...) and/or channels (dolly, truck, crane, tilt, roll, push, handheld, dof, focus, vignette, letterbox) over dur.

dialogue.description: Characters talk in turn with talk gestures, reading-time pacing, faces and a two-shot. lines: [[who, text<=120, face?, bubble?], ...]
dialogue.expands: say beats with talk gestures, faces and a two-shot camera

activity.description: A little game kept in sync (see Activities): the players walk to their places, play, and finish with the ending.
activity.expands: walks to places, the activity loop or rally, and its ending

walk_together.description: Hand in hand (two walkers) or side by side to `to`.

travel.description: A long walk/run/sneak to `to` with the camera tracking the first walker.
travel.expands: walk/run/sneak beats and a track shot

enter.description: Walks (or runs) in from `side` to `to` (default: its scene x). Place the character in the scene cast with "hidden": true.
enter.expands: a hidden character appears at the edge and walks in

exit.description: Walks (or runs) off toward `side` and fades out.
exit.expands: a walk off the stage edge and a fade

fight.description: A whole 1v1: opening taunts, exchanges weighted to the winner, a slowmo finisher, the KO (ko: false leaves the loser standing and dizzy, e.g. before @defeat captured).
fight.expands: taunts, attack exchanges with outcomes, a slowmo finisher and a KO

gauntlet.description: The hero takes on each opponent in turn (travel run/walk between them, or none: they wait in a ring). Place opponents along the stage in order.
gauntlet.expands: a short fight per opponent with travel between them

brawl.description: Two teams; at most two clashes at once; the losing team goes down one by one.
brawl.expands: parallel clashes, losers going down one by one

chase.description: The runner flees, everyone jumps the obstacles, the lead chaser lunges; caught or gets away.
chase.expands: runs, jumps over obstacles and a lunge at the end

defeat.description: A stagger and close-up, then the defeat style; `by` reacts. The victim must be standing (not KO'd).
defeat.expands: a stagger, a close-up, the defeat move and a reaction from `by`

grief.description: Kneels by `over`, cries for `dur` seconds, sad music, optional rain.
grief.expands: kneel, cry, sad music and optional rain

fight_card.description: SCENE macro: a fight-only video (title, intro, rounds, breathers, finale, end card) from matchups. Written as a scene entry {id, macro, params}.
fight_card.expands: title and intro scenes, one scene per round, breathers, a finale and an end card

montage.description: SCENE macro: 2-8 short clips with quick cuts and one music bed. Written as a scene entry {id, macro, params}.
montage.expands: one short scene per clip with quick cuts

follow.description: Keeps the `targets` (default: everyone) in frame; the fight camera.

focus.description: Centers on one `target`, e.g. on the biggest hit.

pan.description: Pans to stage position `x` over `dur` seconds.

track.description: Follows `target` with lead room ahead (travel, chases).

camera.auto: Story scenes without camera keys get the story camera: a wide at the start, two-shots while someone talks, close-ups on cry, furious or determined faces, and the fight camera in fights. A shot beat or a camera key always wins.

cut.description: Instant change to the next scene.

dissolve.description: Cross-fades from one scene into the next.

wipe.description: A directional wipe (`dir` left, right, up or down).

iris.description: A circle closes on `target` and opens on them in the next scene.

card.description: A full-screen card between scenes (`kind` title, chapter, time or end).

title.description: The story title (`title`, optional `subtitle`); usually the first scene's transitionIn.

end.description: The end card (`text`); usually the last scene's transitionOut.

transitions.rule: At a scene boundary the next scene's transitionIn wins, then the previous scene's transitionOut, else cut. Transitions add video time but no story time.

E_VERSION.fix: 1 for a clip, 2 for a story, 3 for a story with depth.

E_SCHEMA_TYPE.fix: Numbers unquoted, lists in [], objects in {}.

E_SCHEMA_REQUIRED.fix: Add the field the message names.

E_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN_FIELD.meaning: a field that does not exist
E_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN_FIELD.fix: Remove it or use the suggested name.

E_SCHEMA_ENUM.meaning: a value not in the allowed list
E_SCHEMA_ENUM.fix: Use a value the message lists.

E_SCHEMA_RANGE.meaning: a number out of range or a character placed off the stage
E_SCHEMA_RANGE.fix: Stay in range; x 60 px inside the edges.

E_SCHEMA_PATTERN.meaning: an id or color in the wrong form

E_SCHEMA_FORM.meaning: an "at" or "to" in the wrong form
E_SCHEMA_FORM.fix: Use one of the four at forms; to is {x}, {near} or {exit}.

E_SCHEMA_SIZE.meaning: too many items or the script is too big

E_CAST_UNKNOWN.meaning: an id that is not in cast
E_CAST_UNKNOWN.fix: Add it to cast or fix the id.

E_CAST_ABSENT.meaning: a character used in a scene it is not placed in
E_CAST_ABSENT.fix: Place it in the scene cast (hidden if it arrives later).

E_APPEARANCE.meaning: unknown appearance option, or two things in the same place
E_APPEARANCE.fix: Catalog options only; colors need their hair/outfit.

E_LOCATION_UNKNOWN.meaning: a scene location that is neither a location id nor a theme
E_LOCATION_UNKNOWN.fix: Use a location id or a theme.

E_OBJECT_UNKNOWN.meaning: unknown object kind or object id
E_OBJECT_UNKNOWN.fix: Use a catalog object, or an id placed in the scene.

E_OBJECT_STATE.meaning: a state or change the object does not have
E_OBJECT_STATE.fix: Use a state it has and a change that suits it.

E_PARTNER_MISSING.meaning: a paired move without a partner in the scene
E_PARTNER_MISSING.fix: Add a partner who is in the scene.

E_MACRO_UNKNOWN.meaning: a macro this engine has no builder for

E_MACRO_PARAM.meaning: macro params missing or wrong (a winner who is not fighting, a finisher that is not an attack)
E_MACRO_PARAM.fix: Required params, ids in the scene, a winner among the sides.

E_ACTIVITY_OBJECT.meaning: an activity object that is not in the scene or that the activity cannot use
E_ACTIVITY_OBJECT.fix: Place a set piece the activity can use.

E_TRANSITION.meaning: a card without text or an iris without a target
E_TRANSITION.fix: Give the card text, the iris a target.

E_SCENE_EMPTY.meaning: a scene with no beats and no duration

E_DEFEAT_STYLE.meaning: a defeat style the audience does not allow (ghost is general only)
E_DEFEAT_STYLE.fix: Kids: ko, faint, vanish, captured or flee.

E_MOVE_RIG.meaning: a move the character's rig cannot play (a jab for a dog, a dog move for a stickman)
E_MOVE_RIG.fix: Use a move for that rig; generic walk, run, idle, sit and jump work for every rig.

E_TARGET_RIG.meaning: an attack aimed at an animal (a quadruped)
E_TARGET_RIG.fix: Animals never take hits: target another character.

E_MACRO_RIG.meaning: a fight macro names an animal (a quadruped) as a fighter
E_MACRO_RIG.fix: Leave the animal out of @fight, @gauntlet and @brawl; give it its own beats.

E_REF_CHARACTER.fix: Use an id from the cast, or world.

E_REF_BEAT.meaning: no such beat (or one in another scene)
E_REF_BEAT.fix: Point at a beat id in the same scene.

E_REF_DUPLICATE.meaning: an id used twice (beat ids are unique across the whole story)
E_REF_DUPLICATE.fix: Make ids unique (prefix the scene id).

E_REF_CYCLE.fix: Start one beat at a number instead.

E_REF_ANCHOR.meaning: an anchor the beat or macro does not have
E_REF_ANCHOR.fix: hit/windowOpen on attacks only; start/end always.

E_MOVE_PARAM.meaning: a param the move does not take (or "to" on a move that does not walk)
E_MOVE_PARAM.fix: Only the listed params, as numbers.

E_MOVE_NEEDS_PROP.meaning: a move needing a prop the character does not hold

E_WORLD_UNKNOWN.fix: Use a world command from the tables.

E_WORLD_PARAM.meaning: a world command param missing or wrong
E_WORLD_PARAM.fix: Add required params; stay in range.

E_CAMERA_START.meaning: the first camera key is not at 0

E_CAMERA_FIELD.meaning: a camera mode missing its target(s), from or x
E_CAMERA_FIELD.fix: Add the target(s), from or x the mode needs.

E_TEXT_GLYPH.fix: Plain letters and punctuation; no emoji.

E_SIM_UNREACHABLE.meaning: an attack too far from its target (use approach run)

E_SIM_UNRESOLVED.meaning: a beat whose anchor never happened
E_SIM_UNRESOLVED.fix: Anchor on .end of a beat that happens.

E_SIM_DURATION.meaning: the video too short or too long

E_SIM_PARTNER_UNREACHABLE.meaning: a partner too far to walk to

E_SIM_OBJECT_OFFSTAGE.meaning: a ball or vehicle leaving the stage
E_SIM_OBJECT_OFFSTAGE.fix: Keep it on stage, or use exit.

W_CONTRAST.meaning: a color hard to see on the background
W_CONTRAST.fix: Pick a color from the theme table.

W_QUEUE_DRIFT.meaning: a beat started late because its character was busy

W_PACING_GAP.fix: Add a reaction, line or effect.

W_PACING_MONOTONE.meaning: more than 8 attacks in a row
W_PACING_MONOTONE.fix: Add a taunt, reaction or effect.

W_NO_ENDING.fix: End with a victory, KO, end card or fade.

W_REACH.meaning: sizes too different for the hit
W_REACH.fix: Use a move that suits the sizes.

W_NO_PROP.meaning: nothing to pick up or give

W_DIALOGUE_FAST.meaning: a line too short to read, or talking over itself

W_TEXT_SOFT.meaning: a strong word for the audience

W_KIDS_NO_HOPE.meaning: kids: vanished or petrified, never back

W_SCENE_STATIC.meaning: over 4 s of a scene where nothing moves
W_SCENE_STATIC.fix: Add movement, a line or narration.

W_CAST_UNUSED.meaning: a cast member no scene places
W_CAST_UNUSED.fix: Place them in a scene or drop them.

E_BUNDLE_RESERVED.meaning: bundles lists base or a reserved id
E_BUNDLE_RESERVED.fix: Remove base (always loaded); declare bundles under their real ids.

E_BUNDLE_MISSING.meaning: a declared bundle (or that version) is not loaded
E_BUNDLE_MISSING.fix: Register it in catalog/bundles.json or import it, and match the loaded version.

E_BUNDLE_HASH.meaning: the loaded bundle has another hash than the script pins
E_BUNDLE_HASH.fix: Pin the loaded hash, or load the bundle the script was written for.

E_BUNDLE_DEPENDENCY.meaning: a declared bundle depends on a bundle the script does not declare
E_BUNDLE_DEPENDENCY.fix: Add the dependency to bundles with its version and hash.

E_BUNDLE_AUDIENCE.meaning: a kids script declares a bundle not made for kids
E_BUNDLE_AUDIENCE.fix: Use a kids bundle or set meta.audience to general.

E_BUNDLE_UNDECLARED.meaning: a name with a colon comes from a bundle the script does not declare
E_BUNDLE_UNDECLARED.fix: Add that bundle to bundles (id, version, hash).

W_BUNDLE_UNPINNED.meaning: a declared bundle has no hash
W_BUNDLE_UNPINNED.fix: Add the bundle's contentHash so the video is pinned.

W_BUNDLE_UNUSED.meaning: a declared bundle is used by nothing in the script
W_BUNDLE_UNUSED.fix: Remove it or use one of its entries.

E_DEPTH_RANGE.meaning: a z (placement, set piece or to.z) is outside the scene's depth range
E_DEPTH_RANGE.fix: Keep z between the scene's far and near (default -2000..600) or widen depth.

E_DEPTH_LAYER.meaning: a node gives both z and layer
E_DEPTH_LAYER.fix: Keep one: layer is a z preset (back -800, front 313).

E_LIGHT_UNKNOWN.meaning: an unknown light rig preset (scene or location light, set_light)
E_LIGHT_UNKNOWN.fix: Use a preset from catalog/world/lights.json (noon, dawn, golden, moonlit, indoor, stage, gloom, flat).

E_CAMERA_MOVE.meaning: an unknown named camera move (a v3 camera key move or set_camera)
E_CAMERA_MOVE.fix: Use a move from catalog/world/camera_moves.json (push_in, pull_out, slow_push, crane_up, crane_down, orbit_sweep, dutch_tilt, level, handheld).

E_LAYER_REF.meaning: a text, shape, mask or parent names a layer or shape that does not exist, or layer parents loop
E_LAYER_REF.fix: Use an id from layers or shapes; list parents first.

E_REF_SCENE.meaning: a layer, text, shape or track names a scene that does not exist
E_REF_SCENE.fix: Use a scene id from scenes.

E_TRACK_TARGET.meaning: a track target that is not keyable, or names a missing node
E_TRACK_TARGET.fix: Use layer.<id>.<prop>, text.<id>.<prop>, shape.<id>.<prop>, lens.<channel> or post.<prop>.

E_TRACK_KEYS.meaning: a key value of the wrong kind, two keys at one time, or a path or line missing its points
E_TRACK_KEYS.fix: Numbers for numbers, #rrggbb for colours; one key per time.

E_TRACK_EASE.meaning: an unknown easing on a key
E_TRACK_EASE.fix: Use an easing name, step or cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2).

E_TEXT_STYLE.fix: Use a style from catalog/world/text_styles.json (title, subtitle, caption, lower_third, comic, label).
